speaker: character
text: Everyone's just standing around. There are twice as many of us as they planned. Do you know what's going on?

speaker: candidate
text: Let's just wait for the organiser. It's not our job.

speaker: character
text: Some people are already leaving. We've got eighty people and forty pairs of gloves. What do we do?

speaker: candidate
text: We don't need eighty people. Let's just send half of them home.

speaker: character
text: That didn't go well. Some of them are really upset, and a whole group just walked off.

speaker: candidate
text: Whatever, it's their choice. Fewer people is easier anyway.

speaker: character
text: Should we split the park into zones? Someone has to lead each one.

speaker: candidate
text: Just go wherever you want. No need for zones.

speaker: character
text: Someone found a pile of broken glass and rusty metal by the playground. Half of them don't have gloves. What do we do?

speaker: candidate
text: It's fine, keep going. Just be careful and pick it up.

speaker: character
text: Here's Asel, the organiser. She looks surprised. She's asking who's been running things.

speaker: candidate
text: This was badly organised from the start. It's your fault we had this mess.

speaker: character
text: It's starting to rain. Half the bags are full and people want to go. What now?

speaker: candidate
text: Forget it, it's raining. Just leave everything where it is.
